message.content: {"note_claim": "The INA's carry requirement applies to aliens/non-citizens aged 18+, and U.S. citizens are not required to carry immigration documents.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "DHS will issue evidence of registration, which aliens over the age of 18 must carry and keep in their personal possession at all times.", "reason": "The page states the INA carry requirement applies to aliens 18 and older and lists citizens and nationals of the United States as not required to register."}

parsed.note_claim: The INA's carry requirement applies to aliens/non-citizens aged 18+, and U.S. citizens are not required to carry immigration documents.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: DHS will issue evidence of registration, which aliens over the age of 18 must carry and keep in their personal possession at all times.
